verdict.rationale: Vue's official guide documents defineCustomElement. It builds standards-based custom elements from the same component APIs as defineComponent and returns a constructor that extends HTMLElement. The guide also covers customElements.define registration, shadow-root styles, SFC-based custom elements and shipping component libraries as custom elements. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of authoring custom elements with Vue.

support.subject: As a developer, I can author standards-based web components and custom elements using the framework

citations.quote: Vue supports creating custom elements using exactly the same Vue component APIs via the defineCustomElement method. The method accepts the same argument as defineComponent, but instead returns a custom element constructor that extends HTMLElement.
